Shell completions (install, uninstall, or emit script)

Manage shell completion scripts. Use 'install' to auto-configure your shell, 'uninstall' to remove, or pass a shell name to emit the raw script.

Aliases: `comp`

```sh
woco completion [action] [flags]
```

Modifies project state.

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | no | Action: install, uninstall, bash, zsh, or fish |

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
